guesses.why: VISITNUM not in raw; assigned by VISIT name match: Screening=1, Cycle 1 Day 1=2, Cycle 1 Day 2=3, else=99. Study TV not provided so these are placeholder assignments.
No separate end-date column in visdt; SVENDTC set equal to SVSTDTC (single-day visit assumption) per common SV convention when no end date is collected.

prep_meta.notes: Root cause of prior failure: (1) renaming SVCNTMOD_STD→SVCNTMOD collided with existing SVCNTMOD column, and renaming SVREAND_STD→SVREAND collided with existing SVREAND column — the engine raised a dtype error on duplicate column names. Fix: rename only non-colliding columns in the rename step, then use derive to overwrite SVCNTMOD and SVREAND from their _STD counterparts. (2) Base step was not named sv_base. SVSTDY/SVENDY are not derived here (require RFSTDTC from DM, computed post-build). VISITPER is populated from VISITPERF_STD (the standardized visit-performed value). SVUPDES is built from SVOTHSP (unscheduled visit assessments) uppercased per the mapping rule.
